title: Generate a new Zard UI block

name.description: Block name in kebab-case, usually suffixed with a number (e.g., 'sidebar-01')

category.description: Registry category the block is listed under in BLOCKS_REGISTRY

x-prompt.message: Which registry category does this block belong to?

title.description: Display title shown on the block card (defaults to the name without its numeric suffix)

label.description: Display label stored in `Block.category`, e.g. 'Authentication' (defaults to the title)
